name: L-Citrulline
summary: L-citrulline is a nitric-oxide-pathway amino acid used in pre-workouts and studied for vascular function. A 2024 RCT (n=20 hypertensive adults) found single-dose 6 g citrulline malate improved 24-hour diastolic BP dipping (PMID 39385595); a 2025 review of 148 publications found endothelial-function benefits more consistent with chronic dosing, with heterogeneous exercise effects.
description: Canonical L-citrulline research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until acute vs chronic dosing boundaries, citrulline vs citrulline-malate form distinctions, and exercise vs vascular indications are explicit, passing the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: nitric oxide synthesis; endothelial function; exercise hemodynamics
